focus: The /doctor:sk-code setup precedent: router, route manifest, workflow, battery, presentation, adaptation guide
answeredQuestions: How does `/doctor:sk-code setup` work mechanically — command surface, check-script contract, check taxonomy, output shape, exit codes?

label: /doctor:sk-code is a thin router: binds its route from _routes.yaml, loads doctor-sk-code-setup.yaml plus the presentation contract; single target 'setup', only flag --prompt=<text>, no agent dispatch
_routes.yaml is the canonical route+mutation-class manifest; the sk-code setup route is mutating:read-only with gate3_location n/a and a script_invocations entry naming the battery
doctor-sk-code-setup.yaml pins read_only:true with forbidden_targets **/* and the invariant that repair is an explicit operator action; exit 0/1/2 maps to STATUS OK/FAIL/ERROR

sk-code-setup-check.cjs = LEGS array (id/command/run spawning checks from repo root) + JUDGES (result->verdict+repair lines) + report() printing PASS|FAIL|SKIP + repair: lines + STATUS=OK legs=8 / STATUS=FAIL; SK_CODE_SETUP_ROOT env override points it at fixtures

The eight legs: provisioning (in-process require.resolve of @spec-kit/shared), parent-skill, root-metadata, guard, sync, drift-guards, derived-freshness, and probe (compiled-route.cjs must print action:route — legacy stub exits 0 too so the JSON decision is the proof)
The battery is dependency-aware not fail-fast: PROVISION_DEPENDENTS legs SKIP when provisioning fails; missing SKILL.md fails provisioning with a v4-layout repair and SKIPs the other seven

Every FAIL prints a repair: command it never runs — provisioning->worktree-naming.sh provision, sync->compiled-route-sync.cjs, freshness->regenerate-skill-derived.cjs --write, probe-legacy->guard staleFix text

The adaptation guide is README 'What Adapting sk-code Looks Like': 4 before-you-start steps (provision, skilled.trustRepoHooks, install-git-hooks.sh, keep authored routing source), a 9-step remove-example recipe, a 5-step add-surface recipe, and a Verify block naming the battery

The sk-code battery's provisioning repair is itself an sk-git script (worktree-naming.sh provision .) and its trust step is git config skilled.trustRepoHooks — a doctor battery checking another skill's infrastructure has precedent

/doctor:git already exists with two mutates-class targets (hooks -> git config speckit.hooks.<key>; standards -> .sk-git/ contract dir via skgit.contractDir + validate-message.mjs), so a setup leg would extend an existing sk-git doctor surface rather than mint a new command family
